title: GLIGEN: Open-Set Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
layout_note: Left: a vertical stack of three full-width layer bars (Self-Attention, Gated Self-Attention, Cross-Attention) with token rows between them. Right: a nested-zoom detail panel of the middle bar, joined to it by two thin orange lines fanning from the bar's right end to the panel's left corners.
grouping: The overview sits on a pale blue-grey background rectangle; the detail panel is a separate pale-pink rectangle with a thin red/orange border and a plain-text title 'Gated Self-Attention' in its top-left corner. Colour families do the grouping: frozen layers are blue bars, the inserted layer is a salmon bar, and tokens are coloured by type (purple visual, yellow caption, green grounding), explained by a legend strip under the overview. In the detail panel each visual token row is wrapped in a rounded purple-outlined capsule.
shapes_depth: Entirely flat, no shadows or 3-D. Layers are wide rounded-rectangle bars with white sentence-case labels, left-aligned. Tokens are small flat squares in short rows; dense thin grey lines between rows show all-to-all attention. The detail panel uses thin black arrows, circled operator glyphs for multiply and add, a right-angle black skip line, and dashed green outlined empty squares for grounding tokens that are not passed on; output tokens of the inner self-attention are drawn in a lighter purple.
proposed_highlight: The new layer is the only salmon bar among blue ones and carries a red flame icon while the blue bars carry black snowflake icons (trainable vs frozen); it is expanded into a detail panel tinted the same pink, and the gate symbol gamma is set in red beside its multiply node with the small note '(init as 0)'.
lesson: Trainable versus frozen is encoded twice at once (salmon bar with a flame vs blue bars with snowflakes), and the salmon tint carries into the zoomed detail panel so the inserted layer is found and read without the caption.
notes: Embedded raster images in the crop are only the four snowflake/flame icons. The token-type legend (Visual, Caption, Grounding) is a row of coloured squares with labels below the overview, outside its background panel. The detail panel keeps the overview's bottom-to-top flow and reuses the same token squares, so the two halves read as the same drawing at two scales.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: A new salmon Gated Self-Attention layer is inserted between frozen blue Self-Attention and Cross-Attention bars; grounding tokens (green) join the visual token row only at that layer, and the zoom panel shows the gamma gate scaling its output before the residual sum.

relations.form: left panel bottom to top: visual token row -> Self-Attention -> row + green grounding tokens -> Gated Self-Attention -> row + yellow caption tokens -> Cross-Attention -> visual output row

grounding tokens are drawn as green squares concatenated to the left of the visual row entering the gated layer; caption tokens as yellow squares entering cross-attention; grey fan lines show which tokens attend to which
two orange lines flare from the Gated Self-Attention bar to the corners of a pale-pink bordered panel on the right that opens it
in the zoom, the self-attention output (grounding slots dashed, discarded) is multiplied by gamma (red, 'init as 0') at a circled-times and added to the skip line from the input row at a circled-plus

channels.colour: two codes, both keyed: token type for squares (purple visual, yellow caption, green grounding, legend below) and training status for layer bars (blue + snowflake frozen, salmon + flame trained); red is reserved for gamma
channels.shape: square = token, wide rounded bar = attention layer, circled glyphs = multiply and add, dashed square = dropped token slot
channels.line: thin grey lines = attention connectivity, black arrows = data flow in the zoom, orange lines = zoom callout
channels.frame: pale blue-grey panel = the UNet attention block; pink bordered panel = the opened new layer

quality.strengths: Tokens are drawn as nouns with a keyed type colour, so where grounding enters (only the new layer) is read from position; frozen vs trained is a separate keyed code on a different element type, so no channel is overloaded; the zoom is tied by flaring lines and the gate gamma is the single red element; dropped grounding outputs are drawn as dashed slots.
quality.weaknesses: The dense grey attention fans between rows add ink without distinguishing attention patterns; the skip line in the zoom runs out to the right edge and back in a long orthogonal detour; the left panel is narrow relative to the empty space beside the legend.

insights.structure: Left: a pale blue-grey panel stacking Self-Attention, Gated Self-Attention and Cross-Attention bars with token rows between them; right: a pale-pink bordered zoom panel of the gated layer.
insights.data: Tokens are rows of coloured squares (purple visual, yellow caption, green grounding) with a legend strip under the left panel; grey fan lines between rows show which tokens attend to which.
insights.emphasis: Frozen layers are blue with a snowflake and the inserted layer salmon with a flame; in the zoom, the gate gamma (init as 0) is the only red text beside a circled-times.
insights.flow: Bottom-to-top through the stack; two thin orange lines fan from the gated bar's right end to the zoom panel, where a skip line runs up the right side into a circled-plus.
insights.avoid: The dense grey all-to-all fan lines between token rows add noise and are hard to read as attention patterns.

arrangement.units: overview panel (pale blue-grey rectangle) and zoom panel (pale-pink rectangle with thin orange border, titled top-left), side by side
arrangement.inputs_as: row of purple visual token squares
